# Valrico Real Estate: Barrett Henry, REALTOR®

> Barrett Henry is a REALTOR® and Florida Broker Associate with REMAX Collective
> serving Valrico, FL (ZIP codes 33594 and 33596) and the surrounding east
> Hillsborough County communities. ValricoAgent.com publishes live Stellar MLS
> listings plus independently researched neighborhood, school-zone, market, and
> distressed-property guidance for Valrico buyers and sellers.

## About
Barrett Henry has 23+ years of real estate experience and has been a Florida
Broker Associate since 2017. He covers all 41 named Valrico neighborhoods and
subdivisions, including Bloomingdale, Buckhorn, River Hills, Diamond Hill,
Crestwood Estates, and Arista. Local market focus is Valrico, Brandon,
Riverview, Lithia, Seffner, Dover, and Plant City.

## Authority & Credentials
- Licensed REALTOR® since September 2003
- Florida Broker Associate since 2017
- Designations: e-PRO, MRP (Military Relocation Professional), SRS (Seller Representative Specialist)
- REMAX Hall of Fame (2024); REMAX 100% Club, 8 consecutive years
- Brokerage: REMAX Collective
- Listing data sourced from Stellar MLS via the Bridge Interactive API

## Content Areas
- Live Valrico MLS listings, filterable by price, beds, pool, HOA, and school zone
- Neighborhood guides for all 41 Valrico neighborhoods, with price ranges and school zoning
- Distressed property guidance: foreclosures, bank-owned/REO, short sales, pre-foreclosure, HUD homes
- Hillsborough County school zones and boundary lookups
- Valrico market reports and home value estimates
- Relocation, first-time buyer, VA loan, and 55+ community guidance
- Florida homestead exemption and Save Our Homes explanations
